title: WendRadioGroup
description: Groups wend-radio children into a single mutually-exclusive, optionally-labeled set.

x-wend-slots.name: (default)
x-wend-slots.description: wend-radio elements belonging to this group.

label.description: The group's label text. Can be an empty string for a label-less group.

name.description: Name applied to every wend-radio child, so they act as one mutually-exclusive group.

value.description: Value of the currently selected radio in the group.

disabled.description: Disables every radio in the group.
